description: THE EMPTY-ACCOUNT-ID REJECTION REACHED THROUGH ITS LOW-VALUES TERM - the paired counterpart of case08, which reaches the same arm through SPACES. Derived from app/cbl/COBIL00C.cbl:154-167 together with :289-301 and :319-338, and reached through :123-127. ACTIDINI OF COBIL0AI arrives as ELEVEN X'00' BYTES rather than as eleven blanks, the first arm of the ordered EVALUATE TRUE at :158-159 matches on its LOW-VALUES disjunct, and the error flag it raises at :160 suppresses the bodies of all three later stages of the paragraph. Every other input is deliberately identical to case08's, so the pair varies exactly one thing and each of the two terms of one OR becomes independently falsifiable. LOW-VALUES AND SPACES ARE DIFFERENT VALUES IN COBOL, WHICH IS THE WHOLE REASON :159 SPELLS BOTH. X'00' is not X'20'; a field of nulls is not equal to a field of blanks; and a comparison against a figurative constant holds only when EVERY character position matches it, which is why a partially typed identifier such as '123        ' satisfies neither term and goes on to become a record identification field that finds nothing. This program spells the two together at seven sites - :114 MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COBIL0AO, :117, :129, :159, :183 as its own WHEN arm beside WHEN SPACES at :182, :199 and :275 - and the two states arrive for different reasons. A map field the terminal never transmitted comes back from EXEC CICS RECEIVE MAP as nulls, and :114 shows the program producing exactly that state itself by moving LOW-VALUES over the whole output map on first entry; a field the user actually blanked comes back as blanks. Collapsing the disjunction into a single notion of emptiness would leave one of two reachable states untested: a translation testing String.isBlank() would report eleven nulls as NOT blank, fall through to WHEN OTHER at :165-166, and carry X'00' bytes into the :170-171 move as a record key - answering nothing where the COBOL answers 'Acct ID can NOT be empty...' - while one testing trim().isEmpty() would pass here and still be wrong, because it would also call a field mixing blanks and nulls empty where this program treats it as data. case08 drives the SPACES term of the same arm; this file drives the LOW-VALUES term; neither alone proves the OR. THE REPRESENTATION IS ADOPTED, NOT INVENTED. The eleven bytes are written out below as eleven JSON \u0000 escapes - all eleven, none abbreviated and none implied by omission - because fixed-width is the wire format (AAP rule R5) and a field is compared at its full declared width. That spelling is the one the module already carries: the production translation names the constant at BillPaymentService.java:565 as LOW_VALUES = '\u0000', its materialise() and isSpacesOrLowValues() pair tests the field character by character against that value, and the shipped corpus already expresses the state this way in the inbound mapFields of COSGN00C/case06 (USERIDI at eight), COSGN00C/case09 (PASSWDI at eight), COUSR03C/case06 (USRIDINI at eight), COTRN01C/case06 (TRNIDINI at sixteen) and COCRDLIC/case09 among others. ParityCase accepts it without special handling because ScreenRequest.mapFields validates the KEY as an xxxI symbolic-map item and carries the VALUE through as characters. The field is declared explicitly rather than left out: an absent field would be read as LOW-VALUES at its declared width by BillPaymentService.materialise(), which maps null onto lowValues(11), so the image would be the same - but only the explicit form states on the page which of the two terms this case exists to drive. THE DISTINGUISHABILITY IS VERIFIED RATHER THAN ASSUMED, because if this file could not express the difference the pair case08/case09 would collapse into one tested branch and the OR at :159 would go unproven. FieldDiffer compares a send's fields and a navigation context with Objects.equals and a record span with String.equals, and it NEVER trims: the only place trailing spaces are stripped is differOnlyInTrailingSpaces, which merely annotates a difference already counted and whose note says in terms that a PIC X field's padding is part of its value. Eleven X'00' therefore does not equal eleven X'20' under this differ. The failure is legible as well as detected - escapeNonPrinting renders each byte as \x00 rather than printing nothing at all - so a translation that confused the two terms reports a difference a reader can see. THE PRECONDITIONS, AND WHY THIS IS THE RE-ENTRY ARM. :107 finds EIBCALEN non-zero, so the cold-start arm at :108-109 is not taken and :111 copies the travelled area over CARDDEMO-COMMAREA. :112 IF NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is FALSE because CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arrives 1, so control takes the ELSE at :123: :124 performs RECEIVE-BILLPAY-SCREEN and the EVALUATE EIBAID at :125-142 matches WHEN DFHENTER at :126, which performs PROCESS-ENTER-KEY at :127. That is the REENTER side of gate G38, the same side case08 carries; case01 and case03 carry the ENTER side and case06 carries the DFHPF4 arm of the same dispatch. :124 RECEIVE-BILLPAY-SCREEN at :306-314 captures RESP(WS-RESP-CD) and RESP2(WS-REAS-CD) and then NEVER TESTS EITHER - there is no EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD after it anywhere in the program - and that is preserved rather than tidied into a guard. IN SOURCE ORDER. :101-102 SET ERR-FLG-OFF TO TRUE and SET USR-MODIFIED-NO TO TRUE. :104-105 MOVE SPACES TO WS-MESSAGE and to ERRMSGO OF COBIL0AO, so the message field starts blank and the text below is the only thing that ever lands in it. :156 SET CONF-PAY-NO TO TRUE runs UNCONDITIONALLY at the very top of PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, before one byte of validation, so the confirmation flag is already 'N' when the rejection happens and not because of it. :158 EVALUATE TRUE. :159 WHEN ACTIDINI OF COBIL0AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES matches through its LOW-VALUES disjunct. :160 MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG. :161-162 MOVE 'Acct ID can NOT be empty...' TO WS-MESSAGE. :163 MOVE -1 TO ACTIDINL OF COBIL0AI, which positions the cursor and is an xxxL length item rather than a payload member, so it is declared as cursorField ACTIDINL and is not smuggled into the fields map. :164 PERFORM SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN - EXACTLY ONE EMISSION, which is why sends carries one element and not two. :165-166 WHEN OTHER / CONTINUE is the second and last arm of the EVALUATE and is not taken; it is named here because an ordered EVALUATE's arm order is itself the expectation (gate G30) and because WHEN OTHER being last is what makes the matched arm reachable at all. Restructuring the guard chain into Java if/else preserves that outcome exactly, which is AAP rule R7. WHAT DOES NOT HAPPEN, AND WHY NOTHING IS SEEDED. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY has four stages and the three after the EVALUATE each open with their OWN IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON - at :169, :197 and :208. They are not a cascade: each independently re-tests the flag, so raising it once at :160 suppresses the BODY of all three. Consequently :170-171 never move ACTIDINI into ACCT-ID and XREF-ACCT-ID; the EVALUATE CONFIRMI at :173-191 is never entered; :193-194 MOVE ACCT-CURR-BAL TO WS-CURR-BAL and MOVE WS-CURR-BAL TO CURBALI never run, which is the one thing that distinguishes this rejection from every other rejection in this program, all of which pass through :193-194 first; the nothing-to-pay guard at :198-205 never runs; and the whole payment block at :210-242 never runs. Every file operation this program owns is reached ONLY from those suppressed stages - READ-ACCTDAT-FILE at :343-372 from :177 and :184, READ-CXACAIX-FILE at :408-436 from :211, STARTBR/READPREV/ENDBR/WRITE-TRANSACT-FILE at :441-547 from :213-233, and UPDATE-ACCTDAT-FILE at :377-403 from :235 - so NO DATASET IS READ, NO DATASET IS WRITTEN AND NO DATASET IS EVEN OPENED. inputs, expectedWrites, expectedFinalState, expectedDatasets and normalisations are therefore all empty BY DERIVATION AND NOT BY OMISSION: seeding a row here would assert a read the COBOL does not make, and the case would stop being the zero-I/O case it exists to be. THE MESSAGE, BYTE BY BYTE, ON BOTH OF ITS WIDTHS. The literal at :161 is 'Acct ID can NOT be empty...' - 27 characters, with NOT capitalised and THREE trailing full stops, exactly as the source spells it. It is not normalised to 'not', not shortened to a single ellipsis character and not trimmed. WS-MESSAGE is PIC X(80) [app/cbl/COBIL00C.cbl:39], so the MOVE left-justifies the 27 characters and space-pads to 80: the working-storage image is the literal followed by 53 spaces, and it is pinned below as the single expectedMessages entry on the WS_MESSAGE_80 channel. SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN then does MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO OF COBIL0AO at :293, and ERRMSGO is PIC X(78) [app/cpy-bms/COBIL00.CPY], so an alphanumeric move TRUNCATES ON THE RIGHT and the two discarded bytes are both spaces. The 78-byte screen image asserted below as ERRMSGO is therefore the literal followed by 51 spaces, counted rather than trimmed. The two images are related but NOT equal, and both are stated on purpose: the two lost bytes are the whole reason the parity contract keeps the WS-MESSAGE and ERRMSG channels apart and gives them different declared widths. There is exactly ONE entry on the message channel and not two - the 78-byte image is already pinned field-by-field as a payload member of the send, so restating it on the SCREEN_ERRMSG_78 channel would assert the same bytes twice while the 80-byte pre-truncation image is the one thing no payload field can carry. THE ONE SEND, AND EXACTLY WHICH ITEMS IT CLAIMS. This case declares unitKind SERVICE, so the unit is BillPaymentService.processEnterKey - the translation of PROCESS-ENTER-KEY from :154 onwards - and the send it records carries the FOUR items that paragraph and SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN write themselves: ACTIDINO at its declared eleven characters, CURBALO at fourteen, CONFIRMO at one and ERRMSGO at seventy-eight, every width taken mechanically from the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COBIL00.CPY, whose xxxO items redefine the same spans. THE HEADER SIX ARE NOT CLAIMED HERE, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE RATHER THAN AN OMISSION. SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN performs POPULATE-HEADER-INFO at :291, and that paragraph at :319-338 is projected by the controller in this translation, not by the service, so a SERVICE case that named its fields would be asserting fields the unit under test cannot produce and the diff count could never reach zero. Their values are pinned by the CONTROLLER_POJO cases case01, case03 and case06, and they are written out in full here so this file states them rather than leaving them implicit: TRNNAMEO is WS-TRANID 'CB00' at four characters [:38, moved at :325]; PGMNAMEO is WS-PGMNAME 'COBIL00C' at eight [:37, moved at :326]; TITLE01O is CCDA-TITLE01 '      AWS Mainframe Modernization       ' at forty, six leading and seven trailing spaces [app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy:18-19, moved at :323]; TITLE02O is CCDA-TITLE02 '              CardDemo                  ' at forty, fourteen leading and eighteen trailing spaces [app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy:20-22, moved at :324]; CURDATEO is WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY, the eight-byte MM/DD/YY group of app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy:30-35, which at the instant pinned below renders 07/19/22 [moved at :332]; and CURTIMEO is WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS, the eight-byte HH:MM:SS group of app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy:36-41, which renders 23:12:32 [moved at :338]. Untrimmed in both titles, because a trimmed title is a different forty bytes. ACTIDINO GOES BACK AS THE ELEVEN X'00' BYTES IT ARRIVED AS, AND THE ECHO IS BYTE IDENTITY RATHER THAN A COPY. app/cpy-bms/COBIL00.CPY declares 01 COBIL0AO REDEFINES COBIL0AI, so ACTIDINO occupies precisely the storage ACTIDINI does; the SEND at :295-301 sends FROM(COBIL0AO) and therefore transmits whatever RECEIVE left in those eleven bytes. Nothing on this path rewrites them. Outside the RECEIVE itself the field has exactly three writers and this arm reaches none of them: :114 MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COBIL0AO and :118-119 MOVE CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SELECTED TO ACTIDINI OF COBIL0AI both sit inside the first-entry arm that :112 did not take, and :563 MOVE SPACES TO ACTIDINI sits in INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS at :560-566, reached only through CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN at :552-555, which is itself performed only from :137 and :180. So the LOW-VALUES image survives the invocation unchanged. Reading it as a blank field would be the exact confusion this pair exists to prevent. WHAT DIFFERS FROM case08, EXHAUSTIVELY, so a reader diffing the two files can account for every line of it: the caseId; ACTIDINI in mapFields, which is the one input that varies and the entire reason this case exists; ACTIDINO in the send, which is not an independent expectation but the forced byte consequence of that input under COBIL0AO REDEFINES COBIL0AI; and expectedMessages, where this file states the 80-byte WS-MESSAGE image on the WS_MESSAGE_80 channel that case08 leaves to its prose - the same value on both files, stated on a comparable channel here rather than only described. Nothing else: the unit, the AID, the commarea, EIBCALEN, the pinned instant, the charset, CONFIRMI, the sixteen navigation fields, CURBALO, CONFIRMO, ERRMSGO, the send count, the empty attributes, the cursor field, the termination, the return code and all five empty expectation lists are character-for-character case08's, which is what keeps the pair a one-variable experiment. CURBALO IS FOURTEEN SPACES, AND THE REASON IS PART OF THE POINT. CURBALI is referenced at exactly two sites in the whole program and both are WRITES - :194, which this path never reaches, and :564 inside INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS, which this arm never invokes. The program NEVER READS the field, so nothing about the balance can influence a decision here; app/bms/COBIL00.bms declares it ATTRB=(ASKIP,FSET,NORM) COLOR=BLUE LENGTH=14 POS=(11,32), a protected display field. Nothing is seeded into it, and it therefore goes back holding the fourteen spaces its working-storage item starts at, UNCHANGED. It is emphatically NOT blanked by INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS, which is not performed on this arm, and it is emphatically NOT populated with an edited balance, because :193-194 was never reached. Do not read the fourteen spaces as a cleared field or as a zero balance: they are an untouched field. CONFIRMO IS 'Y', AND THAT IS WHAT PROVES THE SUPPRESSION. The confirmation arrives as 'Y' and goes back as 'Y', unchanged, because the EVALUATE CONFIRMI at :173 is inside the :169 guard and is never reached. 'Y' is chosen rather than a space precisely because it is the value that WOULD have done the most: at :174-177 it sets CONF-PAY-YES and performs READ-ACCTDAT-FILE, and at :210-235 it reads the cross-reference, browses the master, writes a transaction and rewrites the account. None of that happens. A case supplying a blank confirmation could not distinguish stage one having fired from stage two simply having nothing to do, so the irrelevance of CONFIRMI to the outcome is itself the assertion - and it is held identical to case08's so that the pair still varies one input only. NO ATTRIBUTE IS ASSERTED, AND NONE MAY BE INVENTED. The attributes map is empty and must stay empty. COBIL00C copies neither CSSETATY nor CSSTRPFY - its COPY list at :63-85 is COCOM01Y, COBIL00, COTTL01Y, CSDAT01Y, CSMSG01Y, CVACT01Y, CVACT03Y, CVTRA05Y, DFHAID and DFHBMSCA - and DFHRED appears nowhere in its 572 lines, so there is no red-and-asterisk highlight to expect. app/bms/COBIL00.bms already declares ERRMSG as ATTRB=(ASKIP,BRT,FSET) COLOR=RED LENGTH=78 POS=(23,1), so the error line is red by mapset definition and needs no move. The only attribute byte this program ever writes is the DFHGREEN of :526, on the transaction-WRITE success arm that this path never reaches. The only field-level emphasis the source performs here is the MOVE -1 TO ACTIDINL at :163, and because a cursor is an xxxL length item it is declared as cursorField. NO MONETARY FIELD IS COMPUTED ON THIS PATH, which is stated rather than left as a silent absence because a reader who sees CURBALO might reasonably expect a balance behind it. The program's only COMPUTE is at :234, inside the payment block at :210-242 that the error flag suppresses, and the only ADD is the identifier increment at :217 in the same block. No BigDecimal, no scale and no RoundingMode is therefore asserted here; nothing is rounded, so nothing needs RoundingMode.DOWN to be right. STATELESSNESS. EIBCALEN is 218: the 160 bytes app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy declares for CARDDEMO-COMMAREA plus the 58 bytes of the CDEMO-CB00-INFO group COBIL00C.cbl:64-72 appends in place - two X(16) transaction identifiers, a 9(08) page number, two X(01) flags and one more X(16). The one commarea item this path depends on is CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT, which :112 tests through the CDEMO-PGM-REENTER condition name, and it arrives 1 and LEAVES 1: PROCESS-ENTER-KEY neither reads another field of the area nor writes one, there is no XCTL on this path - the program's only transfer is the EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) at :281-284 inside RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN, reached only from MAIN-PARA at :109 and :135 - and RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN, which is the only thing that would move ZEROS into CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT at :280, is not performed. Control falls to EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(WS-TRANID) COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) at :146-149, so the termination is RETURN_TRANSID and the pseudo-conversation continues carrying the area in the payload. nextProgram, nextMapset and nextMap are all absent: no transfer happened, and :296-297 names the mapset and the map on the SEND, which is the controller's projection rather than the service's. All conversation state - the area, the AID and the screen values - travels in the payload, so no server-side session state exists or is implied (gate G37, AAP rule R6). RETURN CODE. expectedReturnCode is 0. COBIL00C never assigns RETURN-CODE - the identifier does not appear in its 572 lines - and it contains no CALL 'CEE3ABD', so there is no abend and no non-zero exit to express; the failure is signalled entirely by WS-ERR-FLG holding 'Y' and by the screen message. Zero is stated rather than defaulted so the expectation says so. No DISPLAY is emitted on this path either: the only lines this program writes are the DISPLAY 'RESP:' WS-RESP-CD 'REAS:' WS-REAS-CD statements on the WHEN OTHER arms at :366, :397, :430, :461, :490 and :541, every one of them inside a file-handling paragraph this path never enters, so the single expectedMessages entry is the 80-byte WS-MESSAGE image and nothing else. DETERMINISM. The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:12:32, the instant every case in this directory pins and the exact instant the CardDemo_v1.0-15-g27d6c6f-68 version footer at COBIL00C.cbl:571 carries, which reads Date: 2022-07-19 23:12:32 CDT, so the header renders 07/19/22 and 23:12:32 rather than whatever the wall clock said. It is read through an injected Clock by way of common/DateHeader and never from a captured now. Two-digit month, day and hour, well clear of midnight and of any daylight-saving edge, so neither rendering is ambiguous. THE CHARSET IS NAMED EXPLICITLY AS US-ASCII AND NEVER LEFT TO A PLATFORM DEFAULT, and on this case it matters more than on most: LOW-VALUES is defined as the lowest value in the collating sequence, so the byte it stands for is a property of the code page and not of the language. The code page in force here is the one app/java/src/main/resources/application-test.yml states at carddemo.charset.dataset: US-ASCII, alongside carddemo.charset.ascii: US-ASCII and carddemo.charset.ebcdic: IBM037 - three keys that carry no default, so CobolCharsetConfig fails the context at startup rather than falling back. Under US-ASCII the lowest code point is 0x00, so the eleven bytes this case supplies are eleven X'00', which is also what IBM037 would give and is exactly the value BillPaymentService names at :565. The byte is stated and the code page is cited precisely so that the equality at :159 never rests on an assumption (practice B8, AAP 0.8.9). PROVENANCE. Every value in this case is STATICALLY DERIVED - read out of the COBOL paragraph that produces it and cross-checked against the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COBIL00.CPY, the DFHMDF definitions of app/bms/COBIL00.bms, the X(40) VALUE literals of app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy, the eight-byte MM/DD/YY and HH:MM:SS groups of app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy and the 160-byte layout of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy - and it WAS NOT CAPTURED FROM A LIVE COBOL EXECUTION, not one byte of it. Such a capture is empirically impossible in this environment: there is no z/OS or CICS runtime, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler as disabled, there are no Language Environment CEE services, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from the repository. AAP 0.7.6 documents eight independently verified blockers and 0.9.11 records the substitution as risk R-A, escalated for confirmation rather than absorbed. The four reference trees this file reads - app/cbl, app/cpy, app/cpy-bms and app/bms - are read only and were not modified (practice B3); they are the only oracle available. UNIT KIND. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY is the paragraph under test and the migration puts it in BillPaymentService.processEnterKey, which is why this case declares SERVICE and names that class. The service is constructed through its own constructor with stubbed collaborators and its method is called directly: no HTTP, no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no WebTestClient, no servlet container, no JobLauncher and no application context anywhere in the path, which is what gate G51 asks for. jobParameters is empty because a job parameter comes from a JCL PARM and this is an online invocation; COBIL00C has no JCL at all. NO USER RULES GOVERN THIS FILE - review_rules reports that none were provided for this project - and that absence is not treated as permission to lower the bar: the practices the plan substitutes are honoured here, namely B1 with every image written out in full and no placeholder, B3 with the reference sources unmodified, B5 with the untested RESP, the stale CURBALI and both terms of :159 preserved as found, B7 with the pinned instant, B8 with the named code page and explicit field-to-value pairs, B11 with every width taken from a copybook rather than guessed, and B12 with the provenance stated above. The gates this case carries are G15, G18 with a diff count of zero, G30 for the arm order of the EVALUATE TRUE at :158-167 with WHEN OTHER last, G37, G38 on its REENTER side and G51. G16, G19, G21, G23, G24, G28, G32, G35, G39, G40, G45 and G47 do not apply, and their inapplicability is the case: no I/O, no arithmetic, no GO TO, no abend, no pagination and no XCTL. THE EIGHTY-BYTE WS-MESSAGE IS NOT DECLARED AS AN EMITTED MESSAGE, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE: an online program emits nothing. app/cbl/COBIL00C.cbl:299 moves WS-MESSAGE into ERRMSGO and the value leaves through EXEC CICS SEND MAP, so the observable form is the send - pinned field for field in expectedResponse at the seventy-eight-byte width app/cpy-bms/COBIL00.CPY declares, which is also the width at which the two-byte tail of an over-long message is lost. Declaring the working-storage value as well would assert a channel this program has none of and would duplicate an expectation the send already carries. BOTH DATASETS ARE DECLARED AT ZERO ROWS ON BOTH CHANNELS, which is this case's other assertion: app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD defines ACCTDAT and TRANSACT with STATUS(ENABLED) OPENTIME(FIRSTREF), so the files are available to transaction CB00 whether or not this arm reaches them, and pinning them at zero rows on the WRITES channel and at their seeded content on the FINAL_STATE channel is how 'this path touches no dataset whatsoever' becomes an assertion rather than a silence.
